transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for making time on short notice. As we all know, we received a deficiency letter from the regulator regarding our marketed pediatric monitoring device, and we have 30 calendar days from receipt to submit our written response. A draft has been circulated internally, but it has not been approved or submitted, and there are still unresolved questions about the device's software scope, lot disposition, the pediatric indication, and the patient-data fields to be included. I'd like to use this meeting to assign clear owners to each of those open issues and set internal deadlines that give us enough runway before the 30-day window closes. Let's start by hearing from each of you on where things stand in your respective areas.
